question: What happens to a user's sessions when they change their password?
why: Either option ends the old sessions; the counter needs no list of session keys, and D4 already makes every request touch Redis.

options.title: Delete all their sessions
options.detail: Look up the user's sessions and remove them at once.
options.locks: A per-user index of session keys in Redis (D1), written on every sign-in.

options.title: Bump a version number on the user
options.detail: Every request compares its session's version with the user's.
options.locks: One extra Redis read per request; stale sessions stay in Redis until D4's 30 days pass, but are refused.
